svg.title: Diagram 6. Memory: local SQLite write path, RecallGate recall path, and optional v1 Lakebase sync
svg.desc: MVP memory is one local encrypted SQLite file per device (SQLCipher with the key in the OS keychain, WAL, FTS5, sqlite-vec). The MemoryWriter runs at session end, every 10 min or 40 utterances, after each completed exchange and on remember this. Embeddings come from a Databricks endpoint and are queued while offline. Recall: the lexical tier starts at once, the semantic tier runs in parallel with the router, the gate decides within 300 ms, and the judge confirms. The answer gate allows Genie data answers of the same workspace and space up to 24 h, and decisions and facts up to 30 d or pinned. Retention runs locally at start and every 6 h. Lakebase is an optional v1 sync target: outbox push, pull by server_seq with forget_log, conflict rules, backfill, migrations under an advisory lock and a local-key-loss rebuild.
svg.text: Diagram 6. Memory: local SQLite store (MVP, BC2), recall gate, optional v1 Lakebase sync
Rust core · secret boundary: no token crosses
one SQLite file, SQLCipher 4, key in the
OS keychain; WAL mode; FTS5 keyword
outbox FIFO push, retry 30 s to 15 min,
survives restart, HLC guard; forget ≤ 1 min (MEM-11d)
direct TLS, max 3, idle 300 s, life 50 min;
v1 with sync: remote delete queued with
for other devices; Lakebase PITR keeps
history 2 d (D72); the UI says so.
that turn uses local hits only.
v1 multi-device sync (needs Lakebase; not in the MVP, BC2)
a forget always wins; then last
writer by HLC; set fields are
Push = W6/W7 (outbox FIFO, MEM-11a..d; forget ≤ 1 min, MEM-11d). A user Wipe runs remotely on the next connection under an advisory lock (MEM-33).
Hop rule stays: A answers get summary + key numbers + pointer, B answers a pointer only (MEM-25a..c, D60).
W1 sources go to the MemoryWriter · W2 the writer SLM runs on the home profile · W3 items get embeddings · W4 commit to R10 first
W5 offline: embedding rows wait in the queue · W6 v1: the SyncWorker drains the outbox · W7 v1: upsert to Lakebase over TLS 5432
Q1 pre-pass text enters the RecallGate; lexical tier ≤ 50 ms · Q2 semantic tier in parallel with the router · Q3 hits are scored
Q4 gate rules G1-G5 + judge · Q5 verdict · Q6 answer_from_memory shows the card; else genie_ask is sent within the 300 ms budget
IDs: MEM-01..MEM-37, gate MEM-16a..17c, sync MEM-11a..d, MEM-07b (v1; also MEM-09, -12, -13, -35, -37), BC2.
Diagram 6. Memory. Writes go to the encrypted
local SQLite store first. Recall checks local FTS5
and sqlite-vec while the router runs, and the gate
decides before Genie is called. Lakebase is an
optional v1 sync and backup target.
